text:
ria: quick check — hitting intermittent 401s from kotlin client when streaming large responses. Not consistent, sometimes retry fixes it. Using OkHttp 4.10, our SDK v0.9, Jackson for model mapping. Any ideas?

sam: do you add authentication as Interceptor or Authenticator?

ria: addInterceptor(AuthInterceptor) — it sets Authorization header via tokenProvider.get(). But when we retry on 401, token refresh flows not triggered. Also streaming responses get cut off mid-ndjson (last line truncated) after retrying.

kevin: two separate things. For auth, use OkHttp Authenticator interface to react to 401 and refresh token. Interceptors run before the Authenticator. Also watch interceptor ordering: addInterceptor runs at application level; addNetworkInterceptor runs around network. Authenticator is the canonical place to refresh tokens.

maria: for streaming truncation — are you calling response.body?.string() anywhere? That buffers the whole body. Use response.body!!.source(), response.body!!.byteStream(), or Okio to parse incrementally. Also ensure you don't close the stream from another thread.

ria: example of our builder:

```
OkHttpClient.Builder()
  .addInterceptor(AuthInterceptor(tokenProvider))
  .addInterceptor(RetryInterceptor(3))
  .build()
```

kevin: that'll replay the request on retry but if your retry interceptor consumes the body you're screwed. For streaming endpoints you should avoid buffering the response in retry logic; only retry idempotent GETs or use a ReplayableRequestBody for retries. Also set proper dispatcher/connectionPool to avoid head-of-line blocking.

maria: Kotlin coroutine tip: use suspendCancellableCoroutine and read the stream incrementally. Example:

```
val input = response.body!!.source().inputStream()
jacksonMapper.readerForStreaming(MyEvent::class.java)
  .readValues(input)
  .forEachRemaining { ev -> handle(ev) }
```

sam: also check for Jackson vs transitive older jackson-databind on the classpath — NoSuchMethodError for JsonFactory is a common sign. Either relocate com.fasterxml in your shadowJar or align versions with dependency constraints. Run `./gradlew dependencies --configuration runtimeClasspath` to inspect.

ria: thanks. Quick config tips: set dispatcher maxRequests/ maxRequestsPerHost to limit concurrency (e.g., 64/16), connectionPool(5,5,TimeUnit.MINUTES), and set pingInterval if using HTTP/2 to keep streams alive.

kevin: streaming + gzip gotcha — OkHttp will decompress by default; don't wrap the byteStream in GZIPInputStream again. And avoid response.peekBody which buffers and can consume the stream.

maria: TL;DR — switch to Authenticator for token refresh, don't buffer streaming bodies in retry interceptors, use Jackson streaming API via InputStream/Okio, relocate or align Jackson deps, and tune dispatcher/connectionPool.

ria: will try those, ping if I run into specific stack traces. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: deployed patch to sdk v0.9.1 that switches to Authenticator and adds bundling notes.
